verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior findings. Lens execution now checks every slot against the same query-form classifier used by engine dispatch before calling the engine, and the end-to-end hostile-import test verifies that a DELETE in the start slot is refused while the live sample store remains populated. Literal node groups now receive the same click and keyboard focus handlers as resource nodes, with an end-to-end test confirming a literal is focusable and opens the node panel. The supporting unit tests cover every slot's allowed/refused forms and are non-vacuous controls for the shipped default lens. No new correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is apparent in the diff.
